text:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SEV-2 — runtime-service (redwood-runtime) is generating repeat restarts (CrashLoopBackOff) across a subset of GPU nodes in us-west-2. Trigger: 75% of replicas for model redwood/llm-large-gpu are CrashLooping. PD: https://pd.example/INC12345

OnCall-Lee: I'm on it. Acknowledging PD. Starting triage.

Alice Chen: Observed pattern — crashloop starts ~20s after pod comes up and serves first few requests. Seems correlated with longer context requests (~8k tokens).

Raj Patel: Posting recent pod log from one of affected pods (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-15T08:12:32Z] INFO runtime: loading model redwood/llm-large-gpu v2.1
[2026-03-15T08:12:47Z] INFO runtime: kv-cache init
[2026-03-15T08:12:53Z] ERROR runtime: fatal signal 11 (Segmentation fault) at 0x7ffdfab3
#0  0x7f6c2e1a in fused_attention::compute(...) +0x3b
#1  0x7f6c3a5e in runtime_engine::forward +0x2ad
#2  0x55aa1b2c in main_loop +0x14c
Aborted (core dumped)
```

Mei Li: Stack shows fused_attention module. This smells like the new TensorRT fused kernel we onboarded in last week's release (tensorrt-fuse v1.2.4).

Carlos Gomez: Quick customer-impact check — Error rate spike reported by API gateway: 12% 5xx on hosted inference endpoints for this model in us-west-2 over the last 10m. A handful of larger customers are affected (IDs: cust-143, cust-210, cust-321).

Alice Chen: Reproduced locally against a smaller queue: running same model with long context triggers segfault in the fused kernel on GPU. CPU path works.

eng-runtime: Paging in. We pushed fused kernels last week to optimize attention. We need to confirm whether it's a kernel regression or a memory mis-handling in runtime. Asking for full coredump and nvcrash log.

OnCall-Lee: Actions I'm taking now:
- cordon affected nodes (gpunode-15, gpunode-18)
- scale model down to 1 replica for canary traffic
- shift traffic away from us-west-2 to us-east-1 for safety

Infra-Bot: Nodes gpunode-15 and gpunode-18 cordoned by OnCall-Lee.

Raj Patel: Uploading core dump location and nvcrash logs to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/INC12345/gpunode-15/core.tgz

Mei Li: Quick mitigation idea: start a rollback by setting env var to disable fused kernels and force CPU fallback or slower GPU kernel. We have runtime env flag `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1` that will force non-fused attention path. Suggest patching Deployment with that env for affected model route.

Alice Chen: I can apply that to the canary deployment now. Doing a rolling update with `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1`.

eng-runtime: Confirmed that adding the env var toggles a different kernel path that has been stable in prod. That will likely reduce throughput but should stop segfaults. Also request enabling `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` for the canary to get deterministic backtraces.

Carlos Gomez: Notifying customers via status page: drafted message indicating degraded service for model redwood/llm-large-gpu in us-west-2; we are routing to alternate region and applying mitigation. Will post once we have rollback in place.

Alice Chen: Rolling update applied to model route canary. New pod logs show no segfault after first 3 minutes under test traffic.

SRE-Bot: :white_check_mark: Canary stabilized. CrashLoopBackOff rate decreased to 2% cluster-wide.

OnCall-Lee: Now doing gradual rollback to all replicas for that model. Will monitor qps and 5xx. If errors remain under 1% we can mark as mitigated.

eng-runtime: Attaching the trimmed nvcrash stack from core dump for reference:
```
GPU 0: exception GPU page fault
CUDA Driver 12.1/12.2
EIP: 0x7f6c2e1a (fused_attention_kernels.cu:1249)
Backtrace: fused_attention::compute -> runtime_engine::forward -> main_loop
Registers: RIP=0x7f6c2e1a RSP=0x7ffd8f...
```

Mei Li: Root cause hypothesis: TensorRT fused attention kernel has a regression with long KV cache flows leading to an out-of-bounds read under certain sequence lengths (8k+). This only surfaces on certain GPU driver versions (12.1) and with specific memory alignment.

Raj Patel: We've collected the core and driver versions from affected nodes: driver 535.86 (CUDA 12.1), cuDNN 9.5, TRT v8.6.2. Non-affected nodes are on driver 535.108 (CUDA 12.2).

eng-runtime: Action items for eng-runtime/eng-ml:
- reproduce locally with identical driver and TRT versions (assigned to eng-ml)
- add bounds checks in fused kernel (eng-runtime) and bump version if needed
- prepare hotfix build and canary image with `tensorrt-fuse@v1.2.5-hotfix`

eng-ml: Taking reproduction. I have a repro script that sends long-context requests; will run it against driver 12.1 image.

OnCall-Lee: Customer impact update: AR: we've downgraded severity to degraded but under control. Status page message posted. Customers with ongoing failures have been contacted by CSMs.

Alice Chen: Rolling update to all replicas completed. 5xx rate back to baseline in us-west-2. Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic.

SRE-Bot: Incident state: "mitigated (traffic rollback + env toggle)". Recommended follow-ups: eng-runtime hotfix, driver compatibility matrix update, test harness for long-context fused kernels.

Carlos Gomez: I'll keep the incident open for postmortem items: customer list, duration, and RCA. ETA for postmortem doc: 24 hours.

eng-runtime: We'll open a PR to disable the fused kernel by default until hotfix is verified, and plan a controlled re-enable after TRT patch/hotfix validated.

OnCall-Lee: Great. Wrapping up on-call handoff to night-shift. I'm leaving notes in PagerDuty and updating the incident ticket. Ping me if anything regresses.

SRE-Bot: :white_check_mark: Handed off to Night SRE. Incident channel will remain open for follow-ups.

eng-ml: Preliminary repro succeeded on 12.1 with long sequences; creating bug report for NVIDIA and attaching core dump and reproducer script.

Alice Chen: Thanks team. Postmortem checklist: timeline, customer impact, mitigations, config flags changed (`REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1`), nodes cordoned, coredumps and nvcrash artifacts location (s3://redwood-incidents/INC12345).

Raj Patel: I'll capture the exact kubectl commands used for rollback and cordon in the postmortem.

Carlos Gomez: Closing note: no data loss, only availability impact for a subset of customers; next steps: hotfix, test matrix, communication with customers affected.

SRE-Bot: Incident closed for active paging. Postmortem scheduled. :calendar:
